items.en_title: Castelo (ES) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 1 #004
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Castelo (ES) is procuring professional or outsourced services through accreditation (credenciamento); proposals close Dec 1, 23:59 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
